title: Data Analyst
description:
We’re looking for a Data Analyst in Kolkata to help turn business data into clear insights that support better planning and decision-making. This opportunity is suited to someone who enjoys working with numbers, spotting patterns and understanding what the data reveals about business performance.

As part of the team, you’ll work with different datasets, prepare reports and help ensure information is accurate, organised and useful. Whether you’re starting your career or building on your existing analytical experience, this role offers an opportunity to strengthen your technical skills while working on practical business problems.

Key Areas of Responsibility

* Collect, organise and analyse data from different sources to identify trends and patterns
* Prepare reports and dashboards to communicate findings clearly
* Use Excel and other analytical tools to clean, validate and maintain datasets
* Identify inconsistencies, missing information and potential data quality issues
* Track key performance indicators and support regular business reporting
* Work with internal teams to understand data requirements and reporting needs
* Present findings in a clear format to help stakeholders make informed decisions
* Maintain accurate documentation of data sources, processes and analysis
* Assist with improving reporting methods and streamlining routine data tasks

The Right Fit

We’re looking for someone with a logical approach, attention to detail and an interest in using data to solve problems.

The ideal candidate will have:

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel
* Familiarity with SQL, Power BI, Tableau or similar tools is an advantage
* An understanding of data cleaning, validation and basic statistical concepts
* The ability to interpret information and communicate findings clearly
* Good organisational skills and a willingness to learn new technologies
* A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Analytics or a related field is preferred

Working Arrangements

* Location: Kolkata, West Bengal
* Job type: Full-time, in-person
* Experience: Entry-level candidates and applicants with relevant experience may apply
* Training: Guidance on internal reporting processes and business tools will be provided

The Opportunity

This role offers hands-on experience with data analysis, business reporting and performance tracking. You’ll have the opportunity to develop your analytical abilities, improve your understanding of business operations and build a foundation for future growth in data analytics.

Salary and any additional benefits will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Interested?

If you’re looking for a Data Analyst opportunity in Kolkata and enjoy working with data to find meaningful insights, send us your resume for consideration.

Shortlisted applicants will be contacted with further information about the position and interview process.

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Analyst | TWILT | Kolkata | Operations, Industry & Domain Solutions | GPS Industry Solution
description:
**The team**

Deloitte’s Technology & Transformation practice can help you uncover and unlock the value buried deep inside vast amounts of data. Our global network provides strategic guidance and implementation services to help companies manage data from disparate sources and convert it into accurate, actionable information that can support fact-driven decision-making and generate an insight-driven advantage.

**Your work profile**

* We are looking for a skilled Project Management and Monitoring Specialist with experience in project monitoring, evaluation, and reporting.

**Key skills required:**

* Minimum 8 years professional experience in project monitoring, evaluation, and reporting, preferably in government programs, water supply, rural development, or infrastructure projects.

* Demonstrated expertise in designing and implementing monitoring frameworks, evaluation studies, and impact assessments.

* Hands-on experience in using M&E tools and methodologies (Logical Framework, Theory of Change, KPIs, Results- Based Monitoring).

* Strong skills in data collection, analysis, and interpretation (quantitative and qualitative methods).

* Proficiency in MIS platforms, data visualization tools (Power BI/Tableau/Excel), and statistical software

* Proven track record in preparing evaluation reports, dashboards, and knowledge products for decision-making.

* Experience in capacity building of stakeholders in monitoring and evaluation practices.

* Preference will be given for having Experience in working with PHE Department / Rural water Supply Department of State Govt or DDWS of Central Govt.

  

**Qualifications**

* Post-Graduate degree in Management / Economics / Statistics / Social Sciences / Engineering / Rural Development / Public Policy/MCA or related fields

* Additional certification/training in Monitoring & Evaluation (M&E), Project Management, or Data Analytics will be an added advantage.

  

**Location and Way of Working:**

* Base location: Kolkata (on-site)

title: Revenue Operations Analyst Intern
description:
**Revenue Operations Analyst Intern**

**Location:** Kolkata, India

**Shift:** 3:00 PM – 12:00 AM IST (US Shift)

**Experience:** Fresher / Final-year student; relevant projects or internship experience is a plus

**Employment Type:** Full-time Internship

**Work Mode:** Work From Office (WFO)

**Company Overview**

NetCom Learning, a part of the **Sarder Ecosystem**, is a global leader in IT and business skills training, empowering individuals and organizations through world-class learning solutions. We are committed to fostering a culture of innovation and continuous learning while helping organizations build future-ready workforces.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an analytical and detail-oriented **Revenue Operations Analyst Intern** to work closely with our Marketing and Revenue Operations teams. The role involves tracking marketing leads through the funnel — from Lead to Meeting, Proposal, and Revenue — to identify conversion trends, data discrepancies, and opportunities for improvement.

The ideal candidate enjoys working with numbers, is proficient in Excel, and can translate data into clear insights and practical recommendations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Track marketing leads across the funnel: Lead Meeting Proposal Revenue.
* Calculate and monitor conversion rates at each stage.
* Identify lead drop-offs, conversion trends, and performance changes across weeks, months, and quarters.
* Analyze lead sources, segments, and campaigns to understand their contribution to pipeline and revenue.
* Prepare and maintain weekly and monthly reports and basic dashboards.
* Clean and audit CRM data for duplicates, missing fields, incorrect stages, and unassigned leads.
* Ensure lead lifecycle stages and dates are recorded accurately.
* Investigate unusual changes in conversion rates and highlight potential causes.
* Share insights and recommend practical improvements to Marketing and RevOps teams.

**Qualifications**

* Recent graduate or final-year student in Commerce, Business, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong Excel skills, including SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, IF, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, filters, and basic charts.
* Comfortable working with numbers, percentages, conversion rates, and month-on-month comparisons.
* Basic understanding of marketing funnels, lead generation, and lead conversion.
* Ability to identify trends, patterns, and inconsistencies in data.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.
* Willingness to learn CRM and marketing automation tools.

**Preferred Skills**

* Basic SQL knowledge, including SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, and simple JOINs.
* Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, or Looker Studio.
* Exposure to CRM or marketing automation platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Marketo.
* Understanding of marketing analytics concepts such as MQL, SQL, pipeline, win rate, and attribution.
* Experience with reporting, dashboards, academic projects, or data analysis internships.

**Tools / Platforms**

* **Microsoft Excel:** Daily reporting, data cleaning, and analysis.
* **CRM & Marketing Automation:** Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Marketo.
* **Power BI:** Dashboard creation and reporting.
* **SQL:** Basic data extraction and analysis.
* **Microsoft 365:** Teams, Outlook, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.

**What You'll Learn**

* How a B2B sales funnel works, from the first lead to a signed deal.
* How Marketing, Sales, and RevOps collaborate and manage lead handoffs.
* How CRM data is structured, maintained, and audited.
* How to build effective reports and dashboards.
* How to translate data analysis into actionable recommendations.
* Practical exposure to Power BI and SQL, with training provided where needed.

**Why Join NetCom Learning?**

* Opportunity to work with a globally recognized learning organization and be part of the **Sarder Ecosystem**.
* Hands-on exposure to marketing analytics, revenue operations, and business analysis.
* Opportunity to work with real-world CRM data, reports, and dashboards.
* Collaborative work environment with opportunities to learn from Marketing and RevOps teams.
* Practical training in reporting, data analysis, Power BI, SQL, and CRM platforms.
* Opportunity to contribute to business decisions by identifying conversion gaps and revenue opportunities.

If you're passionate about **data analysis, business insights, and understanding how marketing contributes to revenue**, we'd love to hear from you.

**Apply today and become a part of the NetCom Learning team!**

title: Production Data Entry & Analysis
description:
**Company:** Rama Overseas Ltd.  
**Job Location:** Leather Complex, Bantala, Kolkata  
**Salary:** ₹20,000 – ₹25,000 per month  
**Experience:** As per skill proficiency

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical candidate to manage production-related data entry, maintain accurate records, and analyse production data to support efficient manufacturing operations.

Key Responsibilities

* Enter, update, and maintain daily production data accurately.
* Collect and compile production-related information from different departments.
* Analyse production data to identify discrepancies and areas for improvement.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly production reports.
* Maintain records of production output, productivity, material consumption and other relevant parameters.
* Work extensively with MS Excel and other data management tools.
* Coordinate with the production team to obtain and validate data.

Required Skills

* Strong data entry skills with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Excellent analytical and numerical skills.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel and data analysis.
* Ability to organise, interpret, and present production data effectively.
* Good communication and coordination skills.

Educational Qualification

Any graduate or candidate with a relevant educational background and strong data entry and analytical skills may apply.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
